name: 49464 · Zeeland, MI
findings: ZIP 49464 (Zeeland) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49464 (Zeeland) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 49464 (Zeeland) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
